The scores from the predictions suggest a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, though the exact mechanism of Acifluorfen's interaction with Phosphodiesterase 6C remains uncertain. The evidence is consistent across two different prediction models, but further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the biological relevance of this interaction.
